name: Washougal
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Washougal, WA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Washougal, WA: the Lighted Christmas Parade, Holidays in the Hills drive through lights with Santa, a paint class and a beach Santa.
lede: Washougal does Christmas with a lighted parade down Main Street, a mile of lights in the hills at the motocross park, and Santa taking a beach break at a play cafe.
celebrates: The City of Washougal's Lighted Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting fills downtown on the first Thursday of December, with cookies, cocoa and Santa photos at Reflection Plaza before the parade and the tree lighting after it. Up on NE Borin Road, Washougal MX Park runs Holidays in the Hills, a one mile drive through light display with Santa Saturdays. Ashwood Taps and Trucks hosts a kids Christmas paint class, and Little Otters Play Cafe brings in Santa and Mrs. Claus for a beach themed visit. The city's Pendleton woolen mill has been part of town life since 1910.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Washougal held its Lighted Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting on Thursday, December 4, at Reflection Plaza. Festivities started at 5 pm with complimentary cookies and hot cocoa while the Washougal High School Band played, the lighted parade rolled through downtown at 6 pm, and Santa led the countdown to light the city's tree before a sing along with the Washougal High School Choir.
facts: Lewis and Clark camped near the mouth of the Washougal River for six days in 1806, their longest stay at any site in present day Washington. The spelling of Washougal took decades to settle, appearing as Wasough-ally and Washookal in early records. The town was platted in 1880, and Christopher Columbus Simmons, born there on April 14, 1845, is remembered as the first American child born north of the Columbia River. The woolen mill built in 1910 is now part of Pendleton.
trains: The railroad shaped modern Washougal. The north bank line from Portland to Pasco reached town in 1908, linking it to the transcontinental railroads, and Washougal incorporated the same year. When the woolen mill was built in 1910, it went up between the riverboat landing and the railroad tracks so wool could arrive and finished goods leave by land or water. C-TRAN buses serve Washougal today. For Christmas trains, families head to Yacolt for the Chelatchie Prairie Railroad or to Portland's Oregon Rail Heritage Center.

kidfact: Lewis and Clark camped in Washougal for six whole days in 1806, longer than anywhere else in Washington, hunting and getting food ready for their trip home.
faq: When is the Washougal Lighted Christmas Parade in 2026?

The City of Washougal's Lighted Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting is on Thursday, December 3, 2026. Festivities start at 5 pm around Reflection Plaza with Santa photos, cookies and cocoa, the lighted parade begins at 6 pm, and the tree lighting follows right after the parade.
How much is Holidays in the Hills in Washougal?

Holidays in the Hills at Washougal MX Park costs $20 per vehicle for one round trip or $30 for two. Pay cash at the gate or buy online with a processing fee. The display runs November 27 to December 24, 2026, from 5:30 to 10 pm on open nights.
When can kids see Santa in Washougal?

Santa appears at the Lighted Christmas Parade on December 3, at Holidays in the Hills on Santa Saturdays, November 28, December 5 and December 19, from 6 to 9 pm, and at Little Otters Play Cafe's Santa's Beach Break on December 19, which needs a ticket.
Is there a kids Christmas craft class in Washougal?

Yes. Ms. Tricia teaches a Kids Paint Workshop at Ashwood Taps and Trucks on Sunday, December 6, 2026, from 12:30 to 2 pm. She describes it as a kids Christmas paint party with a reindeer catching snowflakes. It costs $25 per child for ages 5 to 12, with all materials included.
Where is Holidays in the Hills?

Washougal MX Park is at 40205 NE Borin Rd, Washougal, WA 98671, in the hills off NE Borin Road. It is a drive through display, so families stay in the car for the one mile loop, and the park may close on nights with unsafe weather.
